questions.question:
A cube of 3" × 3" × 3" inch size was painted on all six sides and then cut into 27 smaller cubes of 1 inch size. How many smaller cubes will have only two sides painted ?

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/accca5df5fd6b7986a8fcf7018940ab98b2a5a846508c02527b6846c3b5339b7.png]
questions.solution:
A cube of 3" × 3" × 3" inch size was painted on all six sides and then cut into 27 smaller cubes of 1 inch size.

The center cube will be faced on only one side.

The four cubes on four sides of this center cube will be painted on two sides.

So, smaller cubes with only two sides painted = 4 × 3

= 12

Hence, ‘12’ is the correct answer.

questions.question: A cube is painted on all surfaces with orange color and is divided into 27 equal cubes. How many cubes will have only one face painted?
questions.solution:
Given,

A cube is painted Orange on all surfaces and then the cube cuts into 27 small cubes of equal part.

So, it has been cut into: 3 × 3 × 3.

Here, n = 3.

Now, using formula: (n - 2)² × 6

⇒ (n - 2)2 × 6

⇒ (3 - 2)2 × 6

⇒ 12 × 6

⇒ 1 × 6 = 6.

So, total '6' cubes will have only one face painted.

Hence, the correct answer is **"6"**.
